name: czl-diagram-forge
description: Offline diagram compiler: turns spoken processes, architectures and data into delivery-ready diagrams across 11 types and 12 themes, with syntax linting, quality scoring and SVG/HTML/Mermaid/ASCII output.

profession.zh: 全栈图表设计与渲染专家

displayDescription.en: Turns spoken processes and data into delivery-ready diagrams: 11 diagram types, 12 themes, offline SVG/HTML rendering, built-in syntax lint and quality scoring.
displayDescription.zh: 把口述流程与数据变成可交付图表，11 类图型、12 套主题，离线渲染 SVG，内置体检与质量评分。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Draw a user login authentication flowchart and export SVG plus an HTML preview.
